Name: Grandma's hand mirror (an antique hand mirror for Fashion Sense)
Author: sweetbeaplays
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/nwMjqNR/grandma-s-hand-mirror.png[/img]

This is a .png replacement for the hand mirror icon that can found in Fashion Sense's assets folder. You will still need the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=description]Fashion Sense[/url] and all required framework ﻿in order to see the hand mirror sprite. This improved version (2.0) looks better on lighter UIs such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1244]Vintage Interface[/url] due to it's dark gold color.

[b][size=4]If you're interested in different, brighter colorways please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21581/]Colorful Hand Mirrors for Fashion Sense[/url]![/size][/b]
[b][u][size=4]
[/size][/u][/b][img]https://i.ibb.co/WvyBv2j/instructions-for-download.png[/img]

After downloading Fashion sense and the required framework, you can replace the hand mirror .png file by navigating to FS main folder>Framework>Assets then drag and drop Grandma's Hand mirror .png into that folder. Say yes to replace file.

If you already have Fashion Sense and own the mirror, this will automatically replace the sprite in your inventory. If you do not own the hand mirror, you can go to Pierre[b] per the mod's instructions[/b] and purchase it there.

This is my first venture into any sort of pixel art and initially just made this for personal use, so if you have any suggestions feel free to provide it!

Downloads.Description: Redrew the gold mirror to be slightly fancier, with an upgraded format and dark outlines to better fit the vanilla style of the tools in your inventory.
